messages.press: A flap: the box jumps and a tone plays, unless muted. Replies {flaps, muted, sound}.
messages.mute: data {on}: true silences the presses, false sounds them again, none toggles. Replies {muted}.
messages.chord: Four tones at once, 1.5 s each: a render of four voices. Replies {sounds}.
messages.loop: data {on}: the looping clip (loop.wav) on, or off with on = false. Replies {looping}.
messages.alarm: Arms a 5 s alarm with sound and starts the looping clip: the ring stops the clip, and alarm() ends the ring. Replies {armed}.
